desc: Derive the coverage reformulation and prove that an optimal solution uses at most two complement operations.
Fix disjoint-pair detection and ensure no sentinel/invalid operation ID can be emitted.
Design a complete efficient algorithm for all zero/one/two-complement cases, including interval-containment queries excluding the chosen operation ID.
Correct and prove the cost-3 constructions, especially distinct-ID extremal choices for two complements plus one ordinary interval.
Add reconstruction of all selected operation types and candidate coverage verification.
Reorder cost-2 reconstruction priority and run all supplied samples.
Independently brute-force validate minimum cost and emitted coverage on exhaustive small instances.
Prove correctness of the final algorithm and characterize impossibility.
Produce a robust implementation plan and edge-case checklist.
